title: Short Stirling EH977
memorial_details: description: Plaque: (Bomber Command badge)/ In this area lie the remains of Short Stirling EH977/ Coded -Z of 1660 Heavy Conversion Unit./ Based at RAF Swinderby./ EH977 crashed on 5th November 1944 after an engine failure./ Killing all of the crew./ In Memory of/ (Names)/ Commissioned and erected by the Lincolnshire Aircraft Recovery Group for the 70th Anniversary/ on behalf of the families./
